description: Soy David, mi interés con el tema seleccionado es motivar a más personas a descubrir, estudiar y analizar todo lo referente al espacio, en este caso los equipos de exploración espacial hechos por la NASA como los rovers, telescopios y sondas. La idea es Investigar como estos equipos ayudan a los físicos de la NASA, cómo influyen en nuestra vida y cuán importantes son para el avance científico.
summary: Cosmic Relics: Silent Explorers is a free, bilingual (English/Spanish) browser game for ages 8–14 about NASA hardware left on the Moon, Mars and in deep space. Players pilot the archivist drone ARCH-01 to the Apollo 11 laser retroreflector and Eagle lander, the Mars rover Opportunity and helicopter Ingenuity, and Voyager 1 beyond the heliopause. Each relic is unlocked with a hands-on mini-game that shows how it worked, such as laser ranging, cleaning dust from solar panels, hunting hematite “blueberries” and photographing planets. Each relic then “speaks” in its own words and shows a science card, and a final exam checks what players learned.

dataRefs: Ingenuity Mars Helicopter completed 72 historic flights since first taking to the skies above the Red Planet.
Spirit and Opportunity rovers were identical twin robots that helped rewrite our understanding of the early history of Mars.
